title: U.S. CFTC rebuffs CME legal stance in consequential fight over perpetual futures
reason: CFTC stance on CME in the perpetual futures fight is a consequential regulatory development for US crypto derivatives.

sources.summary: The future of perps in the U.S. may be at stake as the CFTC argues that CME hasn't shown the new policy is hurting it after the agency OK'd its first bitcoin perp.
